explication: Armbian Build Framework produces customizable Debian- or Ubuntu-based images for SBCs and embedded devices. The documented workflow starts with an operator invoking a build, which assembles a Linux system from a kernel, bootloader, and root filesystem into an image. The sampled files expose supporting target and CI-matrix generation, patch application, and board-specific firmware components, but not the central build entry point or most image-assembly code. Accordingly, documented workflow links use README evidence; implementation links are limited to relationships visible in the supplied excerpts or source index.
